items.title: Asian governments react to Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang’s exit
items.summary: Some governments moved to confirm chip supply commitments, while others are monitoring the impact on local projects or addressing ongoing investigations.

interpret.headline: 黄仁勋离任英伟达CEO，亚洲多国政府紧急应对
interpret.takeaway: 黄仁勋卸任英伟达CEO，亚洲多国政府紧急确认芯片供应或评估影响，凸显其对区域AI算力的关键性。
bullets: 部分亚洲政府紧急确认英伟达芯片供应承诺
另一些政府正评估对当地AI项目的影响
相关调查也在同步处理中
interpret.detail: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋离任后，亚洲多国政府迅速反应：有的出面确认芯片供应承诺不变，有的则评估此事对本地项目的冲击，同时还有正在进行的调查需要应对。

items.title: Jensen Huang and the End of the Founder Fairy Tale
items.summary: The former tech CEO is obsessed with the power of storytelling. But he hasn't spun his way out of his sex scandals.
